q: How do I calculate a seed processing plant's emissions per tonne?
title: Seed processing plant per tonne
short: Add electricity for cleaning, grading, treating and packing lines at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, dryer fuel and cold store power, then divide by tonnes of seed processed. Seed grown by contract farmers is a bought-in input, counted in Scope 3.
audience: Seed companies and seed processing units

ul: Electricity for pre-cleaners, graders, gravity separators and treaters.
Cold and conditioned storage for seed lots.

p: Raw seed from contract growers is Scope 3, Category 1. Use farm-level figures where growers can provide them, and spend-based estimates otherwise, labelled as such.
Divide by tonnes processed and passed, and report by crop, since vegetable seed and field crop seed differ a lot.

example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use the plant meter and processing records.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
